description: Contributed to IBM Project Polaris by developing UNIX command-line tools in C and Assembly that interface with z/OS through z/OS UNIX System Services. Designed a C API to expose z/OS capabilities to modern programming languages and developed a reusable JSON parsing library for z/OS tools and subsystem components. Built debugging and diagnostic tooling to identify, investigate, and resolve security and integrity issues within DFSMShsm components.

Developed cloud and backend services for Camp Wish You Well, a Unity visual novel serving 16,000+ monthly active users. Migrated backend infrastructure from Firebase to Unity Cloud Platform, reducing costs by 8.3% and accelerating development by 15%. Architected cross-platform authentication and account linking with Sign in with Apple and Android Credential Manager, reducing operational costs by 29.4%. Built secure cloud data storage, Unity IAP and Economy integrations supporting $13,000+ in transactions, and a remotely managed product catalog that enables content updates without requiring client redeployments.
